contract_alignment.details: BeatPresets.h fits ARCHITECTURE.md Notes (line 353: factory concept-isolating presets shipped as Stage-4 data, FUNC-05) and the frozen 42-param APVTS contract is untouched. Preset apply normalisation is correct: setReal() uses prm->setValueNotifyingHost(prm->convertTo0to1(real)) for swing/humanize/quantize (AudioParameterFloat over unitRange {0,1}) and tempo (NormalisableRange {40,240}); patternLength (AudioParameterChoice) is normalised via convertTo0to1((float) choiceIndex) over its implicit {0,numChoices-1,1} range, which is the correct path for a choice param (PluginProcessor.cpp:451-464). index is bounds-checked (PluginProcessor.cpp:441). Grid row order in every preset matches the Voice enum (Kick=0,Snare,Clap,ClosedHat,OpenHat,Tom): verified structurally (row0 four-on-floor kick, row1 backbeat snare, row3 8th-note hats), consistent with kVoicePrefix/kGmNotes and the emit path (kGmNotes[voiceIndex]). All six grids isolate their stated concept: Straight=clean baseline; Backbeat+Accents adds only velocity dynamics (no timing feel); Ghost Notes adds vel-40 snares; Triplet Swing engages swing only (hum=0,q=1); Humanized engages humanize with low quantize (hum 0.70, q 0.25, swing 0); Quantize Demo intentionally combines swing+humanize with q=0.50 to demo the tradeoff, matching the doc's 'humanize high, sweep quantize'. Two minor, non-blocking observations: (1) the doc enumerated 5 concepts and the impl ships 6 (adds 'Backbeat + Accents') -- a justified expansion within FUNC-05, not a regression; (2) the swing01=0.80 value for 'Triplet Swing' (=60% display vs the ~50% triplet point per the swing-ratio spec) is a DSP/musical-tuning judgement outside architecture scope and is deferred to the DSP critic.

module_usage.details: BeatPresets.h is plain constexpr C++ (std::array<BeatPreset,6>) including only <array>, <cstdint>, and BeatmakerIDs.h -- no shared-module functionality is duplicated and none is applicable. Correctly NOT a juce_add_binary_data blob, so it adds no second BinaryData namespace (heeds the O-simpleGrain Stage-3.1 collision lesson). Header-only, included by the already-built PluginProcessor.cpp; no CMake/target_link_libraries change required, and it resolves under both the plugin target and the render-harness include dirs (../../Source).

naming_conventions.details: BeatPreset struct is PascalCase; applyConceptPreset is camelCase (matches setStep/clearGrid/processBlock); kBeatPresets uses the k-prefix constexpr-constant convention matching its siblings kGmNotes/kVoicePrefix/kNumVoices in BeatmakerIDs.h; struct members (name, patternLengthChoice, swing01, humanize01, quantize01, tempoBpm, grid) are camelCase; everything lives in namespace OSimpleBeatmaker consistent with the rest of the plugin.

dependency_direction.details: Clean graph. PluginProcessor.h does NOT include PluginEditor.h. The processor->editor include exists only in PluginProcessor.cpp (line 16), confined to the translation unit that implements the createEditor() factory and now guarded by #if JUCE_WEB_BROWSER -- this is the canonical JUCE arrangement (the .cpp instantiates the editor; the header stays decoupled), so it is acceptable coupling rather than a directional violation, and the guard additionally lets the headless render-harness build with a GenericAudioProcessorEditor fallback (PluginProcessor.cpp:522-533). Verified by grep that none of the DSP-spine headers (DrumVoiceEngine/UnifiedTriggerRouter/SequencerClock/TimingFeelEngine/VizAnalyzer) reference PluginEditor/WebBrowser/Editor/gui_extra -- they include only JuceHeader.h, std headers, BeatmakerIDs.h, fastSine.h, and (router) DrumVoiceEngine.h. BeatPresets.h pulls in no GUI. No circular includes; plugin depends on no other plugin.
